area: JackID progression map: luck, Night Cards, bonuses, currencies, meta (read-only). Every citation is an absolute path under C:/Users/Admin/Documents/JackID/.
findings: LUCK IS ONE RUN-LEVEL MODIFIER HOOK, NOT A PLAYER STAT. 'luck' is def 0, clamp -30..30, integer-rounded (C:/Users/Admin/Documents/JackID/src/game/modifiers.types.ts:79). The clamp is applied after all stacking in foldEffects (modifiers.types.ts:237-243). Each machine reads it as this.luck() = mod('luck', 0) (C:/Users/Admin/Documents/JackID/src/machines/_base/MachineBase.ts:623).

ONE LUCK POINT MEANS DIFFERENT THINGS PER MACHINE: claw +1.5%/pt, cap 10% (C:/Users/Admin/Documents/JackID/src/machines/claw/rules.ts:32-33); plinko cap 20% (src/machines/plinko/rules.ts:23); bingopin +2%/pt, cap 30% (src/machines/bingopin/rules.ts:22-23); scratch +0.5%/pt, cap 15% (src/machines/scratch/index.ts:106); coinpusher +1% absolute/pt, cap 15% (src/machines/coinpusher/rules.ts:38); pachinko 0.1% per pt, cap +3% (src/machines/pachinko/rules.ts:32,44); pachislot x(1+0.02L), cap x1.6 (src/machines/pachislot/index.ts:97); lootbox cap 20% absolute (src/machines/lootbox/rules.ts:68); fruitmachine cap 20 pts (src/machines/fruitmachine/rules.ts:49); devilstable misfire L/100, cap 0.5 (src/machines/devilstable/index.ts:81). Reroll-percent machines use p = L/100 with no explicit saturation found: coinflip (src/machines/coinflip/rules.ts:62-76), blackjack (src/machines/blackjack/rules.ts:152-155), cardwar (src/machines/cardwar/rules.ts:131-134), baccarat (src/machines/baccarat/rules.ts:198-199), bigsix (src/machines/bigsix/rules.ts:142), bingo solo (src/machines/bingo/index.ts:228).

CHARM LUCK SOURCES: Bent Nail +8 on every machine tagged drops (src/game/data/charms.ts:95), emitted as a plain tag-scoped effect, not via luckFx. Metronome +10 on cyclone/pachislot/stacker, budgeted (charms.ts:103). Glass Heart +8, budgeted, cursed, F3-coded, not in LAUNCH_CHARM_IDS, reachable only from the heir kit (charms.ts:175; src/game/data/kits.ts:30). Per-machine charm-luck budget CHARM_LUCK_CAP (charms.ts:30-36) is applied only inside luckFx (charms.ts:39-46).

OTHER LUCK SOURCES: tonic Lucky Mint +2 per stack, up to 3 stacks, 120 s (src/game/data/buffs.ts:23-24); Cursed Candy +6 debuff, 90 s (buffs.ts:35-36); nightly event Lucky Moon +3 luck and +10% payouts (buffs.ts:110-111); friend aura +1 per nearby friend (buffs.ts:78-79); hotline 'luck' deal +3 for the Watch (src/game/hotline.ts:174-176); Foundations H1 Horseshoe +1 per level, 3 levels, needs bestShift:2 (src/game/data/upgrades.ts:338).

TYCOON SELLS LUCK FOR COINS: instance 'luck' track, 10 levels +1 each, base 60, growth 1.9, milestones at L5 heat gain and L10 near-miss refund (src/game/data/upgrades.ts:132-144); pit-wide House Improvement imp_lucky_draught, 5 levels +1 luck on every machine, base 2000 (upgrades.ts:219-220); elevator and fruitmachine family milestones grant 'luck+5' (upgrades.ts:68, 80, 115).

NOT LUCK SOURCES: none of the 10 Night Cards (src/game/nightCards.ts:73-84), none of the 11 Watch events (src/game/watchEvents.ts:39-51), no overshoot tier (src/game/data/schedule.ts:237-244), no boss (src/game/data/bosses.ts). Spotlight pays payout only (schedule.ts:330). House Mood is payout only (src/game/houseMood.ts:19).

BUDGET GAP: CHARM_LUCK_CAP (charms.ts:26-36) is documented as the RTP budget for charm luck only. Tycoon luck track, imp_lucky_draught, H1, Lucky Mint and hotline luck are not budgeted anywhere in data. Only the +-30 clamp and in-machine saturation bound them. Headless RTP sims use base mods only (src/game/data/machineProfiles.ts:2).

NIGHT CARDS, the one existing kept-for-next-Night channel: two cards per paid Dawn, one safe (quota up to +10%) and one risk, seeded (src/game/nightCards.ts:21-25, 121-123, 130-145). The kept card applies only to its own Night via keptFor (nightCards.ts:299-303) and enters as a run-level unscoped source (nightCards.ts:321-325). A 20 s timer auto-picks the safe card (nightCards.ts:22-23, 286-291). Deck hooks: quota.mult, payout.mult, x.econ.interestAdd, x.run.pullsAdd, x.pawn.slots, shop.discount, x.tilt.grace, payout.flat (nightCards.ts:74-83). Switch fields in NightCardFx (nightCards.ts:35-48).

Overshoot grants (run.ts:1970-1977), houseNotice (run.ts:1978), surplus carried to pocket (run.ts:1984-1992), spotlight end (run.ts:1997), Night Card offer opened (run.ts:1999), enter('intermission') (run.ts:2000). OVERSHOOT TIERS (src/game/data/schedule.ts:237-244, once per Night, run.ts:1970-1977): gratuity 1.1x = +2 Tickets; favoured 1.25x = buff 'favoured'; uncommon 1.5x = pick 1 of 3 uncommon charms; golden 2x = pick 1 of 3 rare + 5% next-quota discount; seal 3x = +5 Tickets + pick 1 of 2 legendary; envy 4x = restore a lost Soul Mark or +3 Obols. Next-quota discount is capped at 0.15 (run.ts:2400).

BUFF DURATION KINDS: seconds, plays, wins, shift, shifts(n), while, permanent (src/game/buffs.types.ts:32-39). There is no 'night' kind. 'shift' ends with the Watch: settleWatch (run.ts:1829-1836) enters 'settle', which emits shift:phase (run.ts:1808-1815) and triggers onShiftEnd (src/game/buffs/index.ts:92-93, 98-102; src/game/buffs/engine.ts:244-251). A Night has 3 or 4 Watches (schedule.ts:103-110), so a 'shift' buff covers one Watch of a Night.

LOOP GAP: earned-in-play bonuses (Night Cards, overshoot, Watch events, spotlight, tithe) carry no luck. Luck is bought (tracks, tonics, House Improvement, hotline deal) or fixed (charms, H1). Within a run, earned value flows into Tickets and coins. Across runs, Obols flow only into Foundations (31 nodes), kits and stakes. Nothing earned in one run raises luck in the next, apart from H1 (+3 max).

ideas: HOME CARD = a second kept-card deck. At Dawn, after the Night Card offer (run.ts:1999), offer two home cards (sleep, phone, door, a spouse message). Use the same safe/risk pair rule, the same 20 s timer and the same keptFor/collect path, so the chosen card rides the next Night. Why: a proven 'one decision before the next Night' beat already exists (nightCards.ts:1-15), and the home becomes a second choice rather than a new system. Sample cards: Lucky Sleep = luck +3 with pulls -1; Warm Bed = tilt grace +2 with dread -8 (dread.add is a core hook, modifiers.types.ts:53); Phone Favour = luck +2 with x.phone.dealCost x0.75 (hotline reads that hook); Cold Dinner = dread +4 with quota x0.95 (safe).

LUCK THAT CANNOT BREAK RTP: emit home luck with luckFx-style per-machine clamping (charms.ts:41-46), using CHARM_LUCK_CAP as the budget (charms.ts:30-36). A +3 card then reads large on cyclone (cap 20) and tiny on stacker (cap 4). Limitation: machines with budget 0 (coinflip, craps, roulette, bigone) would get no home luck. Say so in the card text or accept it. Why: luck feels machine-specific, with no new RTP risk and no pipeline change.

NEXT-NIGHT DURATION WITHOUT A NEW ENGINE: use shifts with n = nightDef(index).watches (schedule.ts:103-110; kind shifts at buffs/engine.ts:141, 249-251), or add {kind:'nights', n} decremented in dawn() (run.ts:1944). Why: the director's 'buff for the next Night' needs a Night-length duration, and 'shift' alone gives a third of one.

FIX THE OVERSHOOT PROMISE: add buff 'favoured' to BUFF_DATA (src/game/data/buffs.ts) with duration shifts n=1 and effects [{hook:'x.pawn.freeRerolls', op:'add', value:1}], read at shop.ts:276. Add log.warnOnce on unknown ids in buffs/engine.ts:102-104 (the same pattern as engine.ts:107). Why: the favoured tier currently makes overshoot rewards silently vanish.

EARNED LUCK ON THE FLOOR: a 'lucky_minute' watch event (watchEvents.ts:39-51 format) with [{hook:'luck', op:'add', value:3}] and pullBudget 3 (watchEvents.ts:29-30). Why: the only chance-based luck during play; a 45-60 s moment per Watch; cheap to tune; no new code.

FIRST LUCK NIGHT CARD: add 'lucky_night' to NIGHT_CARDS (nightCards.ts:73-84) as tone 'risk' or 'mixed' with [{hook:'luck', op:'add', value:4}, {hook:'payout.mult', op:'mult', value:0.92}], keeping profile uniqueness (nightCards.ts:103-110). Why: the deck rule requires a real cost (nightCards.ts:63-66), so the luck option is a trade, not a freebie.

TICKETS AS THE HOME CURRENCY: home actions spend Tickets (cap 99, schedule.ts:277) rather than a new currency. Hotline already prices deals this way, and stamp rerolls cost Tickets (stamps.ts:21). Why: no new currency; Tickets already read as favour.

BETWEEN-RUN LUCK LADDER (closes earn -> grow -> unlock): a luck chain in Foundations beyond H1 (upgrades.ts:338), or a 'lucky' kit (kits.ts:23-31, Obol unlock) that starts with bent_nail. Obols come from deposits (schedule.ts:313-326), and more luck means more deposits, so Descend Obols grow with luck. Gate the top tier with bestShift tokens (upgrades.ts:379-388).

HOUSE FAVOUR AS EARNED STATE: let home cards move a per-run favour value that feeds the Night's favour multiplier (run.ts:887-888) instead of the fixed table (schedule.ts:103-110). Why: 'the house likes you' becomes a number the player earns, next to HOUSE MOOD.

MAFIA DEBT TOKEN: a home-earned token that absorbs one missed Dawn, using the rope_ladder path (run.ts:1953-1962) or false_bottom (run.ts:1948-1950) as the pattern. Rescue loans (run.ts:1741, src/game/rescue.ts) are a second existing answer. Why: answers the 'a miss kills you' threat with a choice the player earned at home.

OVERPAY FIX: pass the meta callback into choiceOffer (charms/engine.ts:224) as shop.ts:235-240 does, so operators_glove and A/W-coded legendaries can appear in JACKPOT SEAL and GOLDEN. Why: legendary offers before Night 5 currently fall back to Rare (run.ts:2412-2415).
LOCKER CLEANUP: filter lockerCharms() (run.ts:3046-3058) to LAUNCH_CHARM_IDS, or give the 11 listed charms real readers. Why: a locker opening can currently hand out an effect that does nothing.
risks: RTP: luck is clamped only to +-30 (modifiers.types.ts:79, 241-243). Tycoon luck track (+10 per instance), imp_lucky_draught (+5 pit-wide), H1 (+3), Lucky Mint (+6 at 3 stacks) and hotline (+3) are unbudgeted. Stacked, they reach 27 on any machine before bent_nail's +8 on drops machines. Reroll-percent machines (coinflip, blackjack, cardwar, baccarat, bigsix, bingo) have no saturation found, so luck 30 means a 30% reroll. Headless sims use base mods only (src/game/data/machineProfiles.ts:2).

BENT NAIL BYPASSES THE BUDGET: charms.ts:95 emits fx('luck','add',8,tag('drops')) directly, not through luckFx (charms.ts:41-46), so it sits outside the CHARM_LUCK_CAP table that charms.ts:26-28 describes as the RTP budget. Check whether any drops-tagged machine has budget 0 before relying on that table.

UNITS: a luck point is worth 0.1% on pachinko (pachinko/rules.ts:44) and 2% on bingopin (bingopin/rules.ts:22), or one reroll percent on coinflip (coinflip/rules.ts:62-76). A +3 next-Night luck is noise on pachinko and large on coinflip. Any home luck must be budgeted per machine.
'SHIFT' MEANS A WATCH: a naive next-Night buff lasts one Watch (run.ts:1829-1836; buffs/index.ts:92-93). Names matter: the code's 'shift' is a Watch, and a Night is 3-4 Watches (schedule.ts:103-110).

SILENT LOSS: unknown buff ids are dropped with no warning (buffs/engine.ts:102-104), and 'favoured' is a live example. Tickets clamp silently at 99 (run.ts:1358-1360), so a tithe or tier above the cap pays nothing visible.

DESCEND OBOL MISMATCH (appears; verify): the summary obols = round(runObols x obolMult x stake.obolMult) (run.ts:2053), but a Descend already banked the un-multiplied tycoon preview (tycoon/index.ts:701-705, reached via onDescend at run.ts:922), and only the run 'obol' currency is added (run.ts:2073). At stake 1 or higher the receipt shows more Obols than reach the meta total. Confirm with a stake-1 Descend test before fixing.

DEAD AND INERT CONTENT: 11 locker-reachable charms have no reader (see findings on Wash lockers); brass_plaque, photo_negative, unblinking_eye, mirror_shard, and votive_candle's luck clause are dead; rollPawnWindow (charms/engine.ts:195-213) has no callers. Two unlock gates disagree (charms/engine.ts:216-221 vs shop.ts:235-240).

NIGHT CARD BALANCE: every card must carry a real cost (nightCards.ts:63-66), and the safe slot is capped at +10% quota (nightCards.ts:121-123). A cost-free luck card would dominate the safe slot, so luck cards must be tone 'risk' or 'mixed'.
